name: Microduck footsteps
description: Walking on placed footsteps: a footstep-tracking policy, the one tested on the robot, and a FootstepNet planner retrained for the duck's feet that plans one step at a time around an obstacle. The runtime's footsteps branch fetches both when footstep control is switched on; in simulation it lands 5 to 7 mm from its targets. Apache-2.0.
